card.name: Words leading up to "today" or era
card.fires_on: Words in general web prose where the text is about to refer to the present day or a historical era, such as "century", "stands", "modern", "survives", "continues". Often right before "today" or a time noun.

modes.label: Era words
modes.description: Century or period terms in historical writing.
modes.example: the second half of the twentieth<< century>> as they have ever been

modes.label: Persisting into the present
modes.description: Verbs about something still existing now, before "today" or similar.
modes.example: revived strongly in the Renaissance and<< survives>> in some forms today
